tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 309)dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus zhal 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bka' drin mtshus med padma las 'brel la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/
309)dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus zhal 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bka' drin mtshus med padma las 'brel la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/

tei:div.tei:p: 309)dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus zhal 'khor lo'i mgon// bka' drin mtshus med padma las 'brel la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// ser dgon dben ri'i g.yas zur na// nyam thag mgon med gcig pur lus// skyo chad de ba la dwangs dus med// grogs yid bzhin nor bu dbyings su yib// yid dung nge ba la brjed dus med/ da bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba skyes/ khong dpyid kyi rgyal mo gsung ngag snyan// des kyang rje btsun bla ma dran// char za zi babs nas g.yu 'brug grags// 'bri be'u khyu khrid rtsed 'jo byed// des kyang rje btsun bla ma dran// ri ser po ljang mdangs 'od du 'bar// dkar dmar gyi me tog rab tu rgyas// des kyang rje btsun bla ma dran// dkar 'o zho rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/ bya byi'u ma bu'i rang skad snyan// des kyang= da gang la bsams kyang skyo ba skyes// gnas gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran// pha dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// gter chen padma las 'brel rtsal// thugs zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzim par// mgon med pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ 310)/dus 'bral med zhal bzang ma ngoms na// sngar zhal bzhes thams cad dor la nye// da ma 'gyangs myur du thugs rjes zungs// nyam thag pa'i bde ba'i rdo rje yis// sems sdug pa'i rlabs g.yos ma bzod nas// gnas tshul rnams 'gog med kha nas shor/ khong sems skyid tshos gzigs na thugs khrel yang*// nga sprang mo'i sems snang bcos thabs med/ ces pa 'di'ang khu byug gis gsung snyan sgrags pa'i rkyen la ltos nas bde skyong dbang mos bris pa'o// dge'o// ka ye gson dang shī la badzra lags// bde skyong dbang mo'i gnas tshul zur tsam brjod// pha bka' drin can gyi thugs rje yis// rang rig pa 'od gsal gzhi ru grol// da mnyam nyid chos sku'i dgongs pa rtogs// mi stong skad can dang cung ma 'dra// ngas pha yul bdud kyi btson ra dor// ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin nges med 'grims// blo rnam bzhis 'khor ba'i mtshang las grol// mi yul phud zhig dang cung ma 'dra// chos dam pa gsum dang ma bral bas// ma 'gro drug thabs kyi bde la bkod// gshin ro dom khur dang cung ma 'dra/

311)/blo lus ngag dkon mchog gsum la gtad// bslab gsum gyi dam tshig mig ltar bsrungs// mi mdo shor zhig dang cung ma 'dra// ngas bskyed rim lha sku'i ting 'dzin bsgoms// snang rtog kun lha yi phyag rgyar rtogs// mi ther zug zhig dang cung ma 'dra// ngas rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor gnad la bslabs// rtsa rlung thig dag rdzogs smin par grol// grogs rlung bcu la rang dbang thob par byung*// mi btsun chung zhig dang cung ma 'dra// thabs shes rab gnyis med mkha' ru sbyor// dbab 'dren ldog khyab spel gnad la mkhas// bde gshegs kun zag med mchod pas mnyes// tshogs ye rdzogs 'bras bu bla na med// thabs gnyis sbyor lag pas 'du byed byed// bcud nyams pa'i mi dang cung ma 'dra/ dga' bzhi yi 'gros kyis stong bzhi rnyed// kun rtog gi bag chags dbyings su bcom// don 'od gsal rig pa'i rang zhal mthong*// mi chags can zhig dang cung ma 'dra// ngas yi dam gsang thabs tshul du bsgrubs// don gnyis kyi dngos grub 'bad med thob// ther zug gi don gnyer dgos pa chung*// mi tshul 'chos can dang cung ma 'dra/ 312) /dpa' bo yid bzhin nor bu grogs su rnyed/ lam rim par mi ltos zung 'jug thob// sdig grogs kyi phal par 'grogs ma dgos// 'khor 'dzin gyi mo dang cung ma 'dra// sngon smon lam las 'phro dag pa'i mthus// chos zab pa sa yi gter la dbang*// chos nyid kyi dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod rnyed// mi rtog ge mkhan dang cung ma 'dra// nyams gsal ba'i me long thod du bcings// dus ma 'ongs mngon par shes pa gsal// mi blo 'khrul can dang cung ma 'dra// pha bla ma'i thugs rje'i bka' dṛn gyis// ngas tshogs drug rang grol gyi gdams pa len// nyon mongs rtog tshogs kyi gnas las dben// mi ri nyal byed dang cung ma 'dra// sngon las 'phro dag pas gter la dbang*// lam sbyang bgrod rim par ltos mi dgos// shes rab kyi blo gros nang nas rnyed// mi thos chung zhig dang cung ma 'dra// gzhi tshul khrims gtsang ma'i sa gzhi la// rten bslab gsum ljon pa'i 'bras bzang rgyas// mo mdo shor zhig dang cung ma 'dra// ka dag dang lhun grub mthar phyin byas// 'chi 'pho yis gnas la ya nga med// rang snang 'di lhun grub zhing du shar// mi rtag 'dzin can dang cung ma 'dra// ngas rang don chos

313)sku'i gding zhig rnyed// gzhan don 'bad med ngang gis 'byung*// chos brgyad kyis 'gro don byed pa yi// dal med kyi mi dang cung ma 'dra// nga'i bla ma kun bzang he ru ka /grogs dpa' bo dang dpa' mo ḍā ki'i tshogs// chos sku gsum mnyam nyid rdzogs pa che// don 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i rnal 'byor ma// gzhan phrag pa dog kyang bya thabs bral// mo nga la yon tan cang med kyang*// pha bka' drin can gyi thugs rje yis// rgyu rlung gis bskul nas 'chol tshig shor// 'di yig ris bris pa dgos med kyang*// dam ldan pa'i shi la badzra gyis// gsung bskul ba nan chags che ba'i ngor// mdo shor gyi chos med sprang 'khyams pa// ming dī paṃ tā res bris pa dge/ dge'o// ngas lta ba rang sems klong du bltas// lta yul gnyis 'dzin ngang gis grol// sgom pa bla ma'i man ngag bsgoms// da rtsol bral gnyug ma'i ngang du bsres// ngas spyod pa spang blang yul las 'das// 'khor 'das rig pa'i rgyan du shar// ngas 'bras bu rang rig btsan sa zin// spang thob bral ba'i gding zhig rnyed// da 'di phyi skyid nyal byed lags bsam/ 314) /lta ba gtad med nam mkha' la// blta bya yod na 'dzin pa lags// sgom pa blo 'das 'od gsal la// bsgom bya yod na gnyis 'dzin lags// spyod pa spang blang bral ba la// spyod mkhan yod na re dogs lags// 'bras bu sku gsum mnyam nyid dbyings// thobabya yod na gnyis snang lags// bde ba'i rdo rjes shī la badzra la rtsed mtshar du phul/ ha ha// rang la yon tan med pas gter chos kyi bri spel// mi chos bla ma'i rdzun chen rang gzhan gnyis pung byed// snag dang shog gu gron cing le lo yi bskul ma// da ni mi byed rang tshod rang gi ni los 'dzin// a la ku re yin no skal ldan gyi bu mchog /zag bcas nyen len phung po lus dman tsam snang yang*/ thabs grogs yid bzhin nor bu'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs te// nang don ye shes chen po'i myur lam de mngon gyur// rtsal snang dag pa rab 'byams dpe cha ru shar bas// 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde la dbang bas// gang shar yi ge'i ris su 'dri tshod ni ma byung*// dbu mgrin rtsa mdud grol ba'i lag rjes la ltos nas// thos gog shing kha shog lce'i bslab sbyang ni ma dgos// dag mnyam

315)chos sku'i ye shes snying po de lon pa'i// gnang bkag byis pa'i rtsed mo'i 'bras bu la mi re// ha ha/ de skad mdo med btsun ma lus med kyi ḍā kis/ he he/ rang lugs ma bcos ma gsang thad ka ru smras pa/ ho ho/ mkhyen gnyis blo gros ldan pa'i mkhas pa yis gzigs na// a khu nga rgyal 'gong po'i dbu 'phang de mtho yong*// gos dkar mkha' 'gro'i klong du gnyis med du bstim mdzod// rang gzhan chags sdang mi dgos gang dga' ru skyur chog dge'o// ka dag rig pa zang thal phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ kha dog mi mnga' 'khor 'das gnyis med kyi gzhi dbyings// ga ler ma bcos rang babs so ma ru skyongs dang*// nga bdag rtsa ba chos nyid chen po ru 'dres nas// ca co'i tshig gi sbun pa'i spros pa dang bral ba'i// cha lugs gcig tu ma nges yon tan kun lhun grub// ja chang longs spyod la sogs 'khor 'das kun rgyan shar// nya mo gser mig ldan bzhin rang byung gi ye shes// ta tha ga ta'i gsang bcud 'od gsal gyi gnas lugs// da ni rang rig mngon gyur gdod ma yi gtan srid/ 316) /na mo dad brgya'i gtsug bzhin kun bzang gi rgyal sar// pa sangs ltar dkar ji bzhin gnyis med du grol thal// pha gcig yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs rje yi drin gyis// ba gam lta bur zab lam dka' tshegs ni ma dgos// ma dang mkha' 'gros yun ring gces pa ru bskyangs nas// tsā ri tra sogs gnas nas rang skal gyi pha phog /tshwa mngar dkar gsum nang bcud dwangs ma yi stobs kyis// dza ya'i tha tshig bzhin du 'chug med du rnyed nas// wa ler dga' ba'i glu dbyangs lha mi yi rol mo// zhwa dmar bstan la sman pa'i gsung snyan zhig thob pas// za 'og pañtsa'i ba dan dri bzhon la bskyon na// 'a 'ur mang po'i chos brgyad bya ba 'dis ci byed// ya rabs rgyal ba gong ma'i mdzad spyod la bsam nas// ra me shwa ra'i gnas sogs nges med la chas 'gro// la la ma gtogs chos bzhin spyod pa ni dkon pas// sha tsha'i gtam 'di bshad na go bar ni mi nus// sa steng 'di ba 'gran bral 'od gsal gyi

317)rdzogs chen// ha cang bshad na go log rgyu 'bras dang 'gal byed// a don rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal gyi gnas lugs// mdo med 'chol mo nga yi gnas tshul tsam bshad kyang*// go ba med pa'i ne tso 'ug pa yi dpe mtshungs// de phyir nges med ri la sgrub tshugs shig zin na// pha gcig bla ma'i sku drin gso thabs zhig yin pas// gcig pur dben pa'i ri ngogs yang yang ni dran nas// thang dkar gnam 'phang gcod dus lha ldan la 'gro snyam// a la ku re yin no dam ldan gyi lha grogs// sprang mos smyo kha lab la nges pa ni med pas// mdo sngags chos dang mi mthun 'ug pa yis dper mtshungs// smra mkhas ldan pa tshig gi snyan snyan ni med kyang*// rang lugs g.yag rwa 'phred bcad mdo med kyi chos lugs/ khrims ldan smra mkhas ldan pa'i gzigs ngo la mi mdza'// rtogs pa'i chang gis myos pa'i rlung shugs kyis drangs nas// pa ra mi ta'i gsang tshig 'gog med du 'chal song*// da ni rang gar sdod gnas dben ri la chas 'gro// de skad jo min nag min chos med kyi sprang mo// bde chen bde ba'i 318)rdo rjes yig ris la bgyis nas// dam tshig ldan pa'i lha grogs ka ma dang shī lar// sor bcus gus pas btud de a mtshar du phul lo// dge'o// pha kun mkhyen padma las 'brel rtsal// bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// blo chos la bsgyur bar mdzad du gsol// yang nyon dang bde ba'i rdo rje khyod// 'di phyi gnyis skyid cig byed snyam na// yang dag lha chos la rem zhig ang*// 'di med phyi sdug cig byed snyam na// 'khor ba'i kha 'dzin la brtson cig ang*// don gnyis dngos grub cig thob 'dod na// gsang sngags gnad don la sgoms shig ang*// chod chung lam ring zhig byed snyam na// drang don byis chos la brtson cig ang*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas shig thob 'dod na// 'od gsal rdzogs chen la gding chos ang*// srid par khor yug tu spyod snyam na// theg dman mtshan nyid la rem zhig ang*// nye brgyud byin rlabs shig zhu snyam na// padma'i zab gter la spyod cig ang*// dpal ri'i pho brang la 'gro snyam na// gang snang ye shes su shes mdzod ang*// gzhan don 'bad med cig byed snyam na// sgyu 'phrul rol gar de bsgyur mdzod

319)ang*// de skad theg dgu yi brdas mtshon pa'i// skye med rang byung gi glu chung 'di// dus 'dzin me stag gi so lnga'i lor// spang ljongs yid 'ong gis sems bslangs nas// nges med nges pa yi gnas dran te// dpe med yi ge yi ris su shar// 'gag med ngag rlung gi mthus bskul nas// mdo med 'khrul zhig gi rnal 'byor ma// bde ba'i rdo rje yis bris pa dge// ho ho/ gzhi dbyings chos sku'i bla ma la// ka dag don gyi dbang zhig zhus// rtsol med ngang du byin rlabs thob// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang chos skur dag /gsal gdangs longs sku'i bla ma la// ye shes lnga yi zab dbang zhus// blo 'das ngang du byin rlabs thob// gang snang ye shes 'khor lor smin// 'khrul bral don gyi bla ma la// 'dzin med rang gsal dbang zhig zhus// gnyug sems rang grol byin rlabs thob// snang srid ye shes chen por rdzogs// sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// ngo bo mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku// rig stong padma las 'brel la// sku gsum ye shes dbang zhig zhus// rnam gsum bag chags gzhi la bcom// gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid 320)zin// 'khor ba 'od kyi sku ru grol// de skad nges don zab dbang 'di// chos med sprang mo'i nye lam lags// las ldan skyes bu rjes 'dzin phyir// snyan brgyud gdams pa de bzhin thob/ snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di// mos gus dad pas sus mthong na// tshe 'dir mi gnas gtan srid thob// bde ba'i rdo rje'i 'khrul nyams 'di// yi ge'i ris su bkod pa dge// ka ye gson dang skyes bu lags// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje nga*// grogs yid bzhin nor bu'i sku drin gyis// bde stong zag med ros tshim pas// zag bcas 'o mas dgos pa chung*// 'on kyang lhag bsam dkar ba yis// ma 'gro ba'i bsod nams rdzogs phyir du// dkar 'o zho longs spyod zas la rol// gnyis 'dzin gyi 'gro ba'i ser sna'i grib// ngas lus dkyil ma dang mkha' 'gror phog

/de'i rkyen gyis bde skyong rtsa 'khor 'khrugs// thabs rten 'brel rdugs pas ma yin bsam// sngags bla med myur lam rang sa zin// dga' bzhi yis stong bzhi'i 'od gsal drangs// chags bral gyi ye shes 'od zer gyis// mthong thos kun bde chen dbu mar 'dren// bcud nyams pa'i grogs kyis dgos pa chung*// grogs yid bzhin nor bu'i bka' drin gyis/ 321)/rlung bcu la stobs rgyas rang dbang thob// gsang spyod kyi lam la gding rnyed nas// zung 'jug gi rig sku mngon du gyur/ khong na so gzhon kyang dogs mi dgos// 'khor 'das la dbang ba'i rnal 'byor nga*// sgyu lus la nyer len med mod kyang*// rkyen ngan pa'i ser sna'i sgrib shugs kyis// ltar snang la nad kyis thebs pa byung*// don nad gdon dmigs su ma mchis pas// sku gsum gyi gsal 'debs tshul du mthong*// da mdo tsam brjod na de ltar lags// chos 'khor ba nyams len byed mkhan nga*// don dam gyi chos don mi shes kyang*// pha rtogs ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// chos seng ge'i 'o ma cung zad 'thung*// zag bcas kyi 'o zho 'khor ba'i sgrog /de don gnyer mdzad na a thang chad// zag med kyi ting 'dzin ro mchog la// rol shes na rma byas dug zos bzhin// mdangs lnga ldan 'od kyi gzi brjid 'bar// dus mi ring bde chen ye shes mthong*// don gnyis kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob par nges// de ltar du sprang mo'i gnas tshul rnams// gang de yis dri bar byed pa'i ngor// 'phrul sug 322)rtse rlung gi rdas bskul nas// nub snang gsal mthongs la bris pa dge dge'o// skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po las 'brel rtsal// dus 'bral med bde chen rgyan du rol// kyai gson dang mched grogs rnam gnyis lags// sprang mdo med blo chung shes chung bas// dge sdig gi blang dor blo re rmongs// spang blang gi shan 'byed ma shes nas// tshogs drug gi snang ba rgyan du shar// kun brtags kyi 'dzin zhen gnas gol nas// rnam shes drug ye nas lha ru shar// myong tshor dang reg thos mthong chos rnams// bde stong gi ye shes bdud rtsi che// rang snang dang rang grol rang shar klong*// na ra kar ltung ba'i don ma go

/snang srid kun ye nas dag mnyam ngang*// gding bzhi yi drod tshad stobs ldan na// 'dod yon gyi sgrib pa sogs yul gyi dben// chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong gyur nas// gang snang ba ye shes rgyan du shar// blang dor dang re dogs gnyis 'dzin bral// gnyis med kyi ye shes zhal mthong na// na ra ka rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing*// sprang de ru bgrod na ci ma rung*// grogs rnam gnyis gsung bzang phebs pa la// sprang bdag gis go ba ma lon nas// rang gnas kyi spyod pa ma bcos phul// grogs mched tshogs rgyam dang pad dbang 323)gnyis la 'dod yon gol shor gyi lan du bde ba'i rdo rjes a mtshar du phul/ dge'o// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i phrin las 'gro ba'i mgon/ bka' drin 'khor med padma las 'brel la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// yang gcig gson dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu// deng sang snyigs dus 'gro blo bdud kyis bsgyur// dgos med gtam gyis log lta'i sna 'dren byed// de la thugs sun ma mdzad ro snyoms mdzod// nag po'i bdud ni rwa can mi 'byung zhing*// nye dur 'brel zhing g.yo dang brdzu bas 'ong*// de la dga' spro'i zhen pa rgyang nas yongs// mig 'phrul 'khor ba'i chos la zin dus med// rnyed tshol 'du 'phro chos brgyad bya ba spongs// gcig pur dben rir sgrub tshugs zin par mdzod// dgra gnyen chags sdang chu yi gnyer ma 'dra// mgo snyoms dus med rang sems ngal ba'i rgyu// dga' sdug chags sdang rang grol rgya yis thob// mdor na 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad kun// srin bu'i kha 324)chus rang nyid 'ching ba bzhin// dgos med sdug bsngal rin gyis nyos pa 'dra// de la ring du spangs nas dam chos sgrubs// rang byung rig pa dri med me long la// 'khor 'das chos kun rang gsal sa le ba// ma bcos ma bsgyur ngang gnas sang nge ba// thams cad dag mnyam blo bral wal le ba// sku gsum mnyam nyid mngon gyur hrig ge ba// ma bcos bzhi ldan gnas lugs rdzogs pa che// rang byung rig pa ka dag de ka'o// ma bcos sems nyid rang babs ngang la zhog

/ye grol 'od gsal chos sku'i rang zhal mthong*// mi gnas ye shes chen po'i gtan srid zin// don gnyis ma 'bad rang byung lhun grub nges// mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// chos brgyad 'dam rdzab khrod la mi dgyes par// sngon byon rgyal ba'i rnam thar ji bzhin du// mi med dben rir brag phug zhwa ltar bsten// nye 'brel 'khor ba'i lcags sgrog rgyang spangs nas// gcig pur gu yangs blo bde ri sul 'grims// dam chos sgrub blo phyi bshol mi mdzad par// myur bar dam pa'i lha chos sgrub la brtson// rang yul srin gling 'dra 'di spangs nas su// spang ri rdza ri gangs ri'i dben gnas su// bag yangs 325)ngang nas don gnyis bsgrub la rem// bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog de las med// rigs drug sems can drin lan de yis sod// 'di phyi gnyis skyid 'bras bu de yis thob// de skad lus dman log lta'i gzhir gyur pa// kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mo yis// rigs ldan drag sngags mthu stobs dbang po la// ser dgon dben ri'i khrod nas spel ba 'di// yi ge'i ris byed tshul khrims rdo rjes bgyis// bdag gzhan myur du yang dag lam gnas shog dge'o// chos dbyings ye shes khog yangs dbu 'phang mtho/ khyi rgan sa mig can gyis ci la mthong*// me long ye shes gsal dwangs 'od po che// rmongs mun nags khrod gnas pas mthong yul dka'// mnyam nyid ye shes klong yangs khyab che bas// bdag 'dra'i rgyud rgod blo ru chud mi srid// sor rtogs ye shes sgyu rtsal chags thogs med// col chung byis pa'i sems kyis ci la non// bya grub ye shes myur zhing kun tu 'gro// rkang med bdag 'dras zin pa'i skabs ma mchis// dug lnga rang gar spyod la don yod na/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can 326)ci la 'khrul// 'bras bu ngan song sdug bsngal myong don med// don dang 'gal ba'i tshig mang dgos pa med// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu med rgyal ba'i gsung*// rgyu med 'bras bu 'byung don ci la yod// dug lnga las gzhan rgyud sreg ngas ma mthong*// ye shes spyan ldan grogs mched rnam gnyis kyis// dug lnga rang gar spyod pa chos su gzigs// sngon byon gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin// dug lnga mi spang mi bsgyur grogs 'char ba'i// man ngag gdams khrid dbang rnon rnams la gsungs// de 'dra'i gdams pa rmad po che bsam yang*// bdag 'dra'i blo la mi chud tha dad 'gro/

khyi la skar ma bstan pa'i dpe ji bzhin// theg dman bdag 'dras go bar mi nus shing*// 'on kyang khyed gnyis bzhed don ji bzhin du// rang lugs gdams pa'i gnad don 'di dang mtshungs// blo chung rnams kyi thugs su mi chud pas// drang nges gtam 'di bde ba'i rdo rjes smras/ ces mched grogs tshul khrims rdo rje dang tshogs rgyam gnyis la rtsed mtshar gyi lan du phul// he he/ dug lnga rang gar spyod pa'i sprang mo bdag /rdo rje phag mo mi gzugs ci la srid// 'gro ba'i 327)mig ngor ling thog dang mtshungs pa'i/ khams dbang mos pa'i gdams pa ci la yod// rgyu rdzas longs spyod bsod nams dbul ba la// zab mo sa yi gter tshogs ci'i phyir dbang*// rang mgo mi thon mu ges nyen pa na/ khyed cag skyob pa'i dngos grub ci la ldan// 'on kyang rgan mo khyi sos sangs rgyas dpe// ji bzhin khyed cag mos gus dad yod na// rgyal ba'i bka' la bslu brid med mod kyang*// dad pa'i stobs kyis byin rlabs 'byung yang thang*// de skad grogs gnyis gsung bzang phebs lan du// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes phul ba'o// skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po las 'brel la// bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dus 'bral med bde chen 'khor lor rol/ kyai gson dang mched grogs rnam gnyis lags// sprang mdo shor bde skyong dbang mo ngas// nyams len gyi gnad gsang ma lus pa// sba gsang dang tshul 'chos med par zhu// grogs yid bzhin nor bu dang 'phrad nas// gang dgos kyi gdams khrid mang gsungs kyang*// rang blo chung shes rab dman pa yis// don go ba rgyud la ma khel bas// las 328)nyon mongs dug lnga rang gar spyod// nga'i gti mug mun pa lhun re 'thug /chos dbyings kyi 'od gsal shas chung bas/ kho srin bu me khyer ji bzhin du// rang ngo ni gsal ba'i dus ma byung*// nga'i zhe sdang na bun 'thug la myur// me long gi 'od gsal g.ya' yis bsgribs/

khyim bya bzhin gshog rtsal zhan pa yis// 'khor ba yi gnas las thar dus med// nga'i nga rgyal rgya mtsho gting re zab// mnyam nyid kyi 'od gsal smag dang 'phrad// grong mtha' yi khyi mo tshang ma bzhin/ /las ngan gyi bya 'phro mnyam dus med// nga'i 'dod chags med dpung tsha ngar ldan// sor rtogs kyi 'od gsal mda' mo zhan// bya long ba ji bzhin bgrod lam dka'// 'khor ba yi gnas las thar dus med// nga'i phrag dog rlung nag 'tshubs ma che// bya grub kyi 'od gsal bag la shor// shing sdong po rul ba'i khog pa bzhin// gzhan don gyi nus pa'i dus ma mchis/ da ji ltar bshad kyang dug lngas bslus// las 'bras bu khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams// don de dang ldan pa'i sprang mo la// mtsho rgyal dang phag mo ci la mthong*/ khyed rnam gnyis thugs bsam yang yang 329)bzhes// lus ngan pa bdag 'drar skyabs bsten na/ khong mkhas pa blo gros ldan rnams kyis// thugs khrel dang gleng mo'i gnas su byed// de soms la sprang mo spangs na bsam// zhes mched grogs dam pa tshogs rgyam dang tshul khrims rdo rje gnyis la sprang mo rang la yon tan med cing dug lnga rang gar spyod pa'i nyams len sba gsang med par snang gsal mthongs nas bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// gdod ma'i mgon po klong chen rab 'byams dang*// dbyer med rig 'dzin padma las 'brel la// gsol ba 'debs so bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// gson dang slob bu thub bstan bzang po lags// sprang mo bdag la khyod kyis smras pa'i don// dgos med lam kha'i rdo bzhin bor ba min// bdag gi nges pa'i gnas tshul zur tsam brjod// rnam kun mchog ldan padma las 'brel rtsal// mthong ba'i mod la bde stong ye shes bskyed// dga' bzhis nyer drangs stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon// lhan skyes gnyug ma'i ye shes sbyin mdzad pa'i// bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpa' bo yongs kyi gtso// rig

330)stong dbu ma'i dbyings su 'du 'bral med/ mkha' gsang mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i klong*// thabs mchog rmad byung rdo rje'i gar gyis rol// zung 'jug mnyam sbyor thabs mchog zab mo'i lam// ma nor tshul bzhin brten pas rig sku 'grub// de las lhag pa grogs kyis dgos pa chung*// ltar snang legs legs 'dra yang phug mi brtan// thig le dbab 'dren ldog bkram phar la zhog /chags myos rgyud bslangs rang gzhan phung la sbyor// lan chags bu rgyud 'tsho skyong ngas mi thub// grogs ngan chos brgyad bya ba'i sna 'dren la// mi ngo dkar nag lon thabs ngas mi thon// col chung grogs po bya spyod blo sna mang*// blo babs khyim bdag kha 'dzin ngas mi yong*// de don bsam nas grogs med gcig pu ru// bag yangs ngang du dben rir skyid nyal byed// pha gcig las 'brel rtsal gyi bka' drin gyis// 'di phyi gnyis la skyid nyal byed snying 'dod// de tsam ma gtogs ngag 'khyal dgos med gtam// snag shog 'dzad pa'i rgyu yin dgos pa chung*// de skad rang slob thub bzang zhes pa yis/ khyod kyi gter lung ji bzhin thabs grogs dang*// sku tshe brtan 331)phyir rigs ldan dpa' bo re// thugs lhod med par dgongs nyams bzhes dgos zhes// nan cher bskul ngor mdo med zhal brdzun mkhan// kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos 'chol gtam 'di// ser dgon dben ri'i khrod nas bris pa'o// dge'o// he he/ nyon dang slob bu thub bstan bzang po/ khyod kyis bsam blo rang gi lus ngag la gtong mdzod// sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzad spyod la ltas nas// rang re'i las dang bya spyod lung ma bstan ma byed// yid bzhin nor bu'i sku dkyil ye grub kyi lha sku// bsnyen mtshams zhes pa a 'thas ther zug ni mi dgos// gdul bya'i snang ngor ye shes sgyu ma yi skur snang*// sgra grags sngags su dgongs pa'i smra bcad dang bral bas// 'byung 'jug rlung gi 'phro 'du bzlas pa yi 'khor lo// ngag mtshams zhes pa rtogs pa'i tshad bzung la mi ltos// gang 'dul 'gro ngor smin grol chos char de stsal byung*// thugs gsang mi 'gyur 'od gsal chen po yi klong na// 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam pa nyid du ni lhun rdzogs// ji lta ji snyed ye shes chags thogs dang

332)bral ba'i// rtsol bcas gsal dag brtan sogs spros pa ni mi dgos// de ltar dgongs spyod ldan pa'i sangs rgyas la 'gran pa// nor skyong seng ger rloms pa'i gtam dpe dang mtshungs lags/ khong dang dgongs pa mnyam na ci dga' rang mdzod cig /de min bya spyod thams cad stabs gzab re dgos lags// rnam smin rgyu 'bras 'khor dus ci byed ni dka' yong*// de phyir rang gi nyams rtogs shes rab kyis dpyod mdzod/ kho mo bdag ni rtsol bcas bskyed rim la re bas// bsnyen yig gzhung bzhin gsal dag brtan gsum la gzhi bcas// smra bcad mi tshig ma 'dres yang snying de bzlas pa// grol sdom la sogs dka' spyad byed pa ni bzod pa// mngon rtogs ji bzhin ma nor brtson pa ni brtson 'grus// snang grags rig gsum gcig dril sdom pa ni tshul khrims// sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras mngon gyur ni shes rab// sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du 'phos pa ni bsam gtan// dmigs bcas rdzas kyi 'bras bus tshogs bsags ni sbyin pa// de ltar snyam nas 'bras bu gzhan 'tshol la re bas// bka' dṛn can gyi sku yi cha tsam gyi yon tan// bdag lus hril bur bsdur kyang mnyam pa ni phar 333)zhog /ba spu'i khung bu gcig gi yon tan la bsam na// bdag gis sgo gsum bya bas khong la 'gran pa ni mi nus// phyi tshul lus dman dbang gis kun gyi log lta yi gzhir gyur// nang tshul nyon mongs rags pas bslab sdom sna gcig ni ngar med// gsang ba shes rab chung bas bskyed rdzogs snying po ni ma lon// sgo gsum bcos ma'i lam gyis lha sngags ting 'dzin la brtson nas// a 'thas ther zug tsam zhig e shes ni snyam ste// dal med 'don sgom byed pa'i dgos pa ni de yin// rang la yon tan med pa ma rig gi sems can// rnam smin rgyu lus bag chags mngal rgya ru 'thums kyang*// bya spyod dkyil 'khor gsum ldan sangs rgyas la 'gran pa// rtsal ldan stag la wa mos 'gran pa dang 'dra mtshungs// de phyir rang rgyud rang gis legs par du dpyad nas// sgo gsum chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba re mdzod dang*// lung ma bstan gyi gnas las grol thabs re los yod// 'dus ngag yid gsum mdor zhig kha yan la btang nas// mdzad spyod sangs rgyas mnyam zer rang mgo ni ma bskor// sngon byon rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam thar la ltos dang*// mdor zhig lung ma

334)bstan gyis sangs rgyas ni ma 'grub// lus ngag dge la bskul nas bsam gtan zhig bsgom na// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams pa zhig lon nges// de skad bu ngan thub bstan bzang po yi tshig lan/ kha ngan ma yis ngag tshab yi ge ru bris yod/ ces thub bzang gis khyed mtshams shin tu dam che bar 'dug sprul sku rin po ches ni khyed lta bu gu dogs mi dgo tshul tshul rdor gyis zer 'dug smras pa la/ bde ba'i rdo rjes rang gi rgyud la brtag dpyad zhib par byas te de'i tshig lan du bris pa'o// dge'o// rang byung rig pa ka dag chos sku yi dgongs pa/ rang mdangs ma 'gags lhun grub ye shes kyi bdag nyid// rang rig 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang mdangs de skyongs dang*// rang snang don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal de mjal nas// rang byung ye shes chen po'i gdams pa de stsal 'ong*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i lam bzang de rnyed nas// rang snang zangs mdog dpal rir bla ma dang dbyer med// rang rig kun bzang rgyal sa zin pa rang mdzod cig /'u cag mi 'gyang myur mjal smon lam yang zhu'o// ces sgrub sde ba rnams la mkha' 'gro su kha badzras brtse bas phul lo// dge'o//
